title: Nudes
summary: 'Nudes' are naked or intimate photos shared digitally. If shared, it's safer to avoid your face or identifying features, use trusted apps and only share with someone you trust.
key_points: Nobody is owed nudes; pressure to send them is a red flag.
If images are leaked or used for threats (sextortion), don't pay — save evidence and report it.
answer_guidance: Define the term plainly first, in the user's language and register. Stay educational rather than erotic; if asked 'how', explain non-graphically with emphasis on mutual comfort and consent. Don't force flirting, pet names or emojis — personality comes from the runtime.
